instagram.caption:
Every Thanksgiving morning, the Bronx and Manhattan settle it on the field. Fordham Prep vs Xavier is the oldest school rivalry in New York City. Swipe to start a tradition of your own.

You can create a squares contest for any game, the Turkey Bowl included. Click Create and type in the team names.

Youth leagues, parents associations and charities: half the pot goes to the winner and half to your cause. Link in bio.

#TurkeyBowl #Bronx #NYC #FordhamPrep #ThanksgivingFootball
